## Description {#details}

The <code>src</code> folder contains the core implementation files for the µTest++ testing framework. This folder provides the primary logic for test suite and test case management, test runner execution, result reporting, mathematical utilities, and other supporting mechanisms.

All source files within this folder are responsible for the runtime behaviour and internal workings of the framework. The implementations are optimised for both embedded and general C++ environments, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and portability.

The organisation of the <code>src</code> folder promotes maintainability and modularity by maintaining a clear separation between public interface declarations (located in the <code>include</code> folder) and implementation details. This structure supports professional development practices and facilitates straightforward integration and extension of the framework.
